assert_max_traces: wrap a JAX function with assert_max_traces to check it is traced at most n times during execution
assert_equal: use assert_equal to check that two objects are equal as determined by the equals operator
assert_shape: use assert_shape to verify that arrays match an expected shape pattern with optional ellipsis and set matching
assert_trees_all_close: use assert_trees_all_close to check that all tree leaves have approximately equal values within tolerance
assert_tree_all_finite: use assert_tree_all_finite to verify that all leaves in a pytree contain finite numeric values
